ceu: ✦ The trine between Mars and Uranus

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, relationships and conversations: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, routine and money: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, romance and your image: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, family and your inner life: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, conversations and friendships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, money and your career: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your image and your horizons: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and intimacy: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, friendships and relationships: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your career and routine: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and romance: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.

The trine between Mars and Uranus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and family: Mars brings courage and initiative, Uranus brings surprises and the urge to change. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.
